summary: Mounted the FX Worker /ocr/* route needed by iOS TestFlight 2.2.0 (2705), added App Attest/Azure DI proxy modules and route/auth/monitoring tests, and kept the Azure OCR key out of source. Proof: focused OCR tests passed 12/12, npm run check passed 228/228 after generating 2026-06-10 artifacts, and wrangler dry-run bundled with ATTEST_KV plus AZURE_OCR_ENDPOINT; production still needs deploy/probe because live /ocr/scan currently returns route-level 404.

Deployed the OCR Worker route through GitHub Actions run 27244503863 on commit 021e913fc7ed1aa82e68538747b73e9515697593 after local wrangler deploy/secret-list hit Cloudflare auth code 10000. Live proof: /health reports release 021e913fc7ed1aa82e68538747b73e9515697593, /ocr/challenge returns 200, empty-image POST /ocr/scan with soft-fail returns 400 BAD_REQUEST instead of route-level 404, and npm run smoke:deploy is OK for 2026-06-10; next proof is a real TestFlight 2705 scan or post-fix Sentry observation.

Added an optional-secret-managed LLM-only OCR kill switch that preserves Azure and the /ocr/analyze v2 HTTP 200 partial contract, prevents cached LLM success from bypassing disable, survives routine deploys, and cannot survive re-enable. Proof: focused 36/36, OCR 202/202, full Node 613/613 plus Worker 13/13, smoke green, root and named Wrangler dry-runs green, independent review findings closed; no deploy or provider call occurred.

Claimed an isolated origin/main@4d747f5b lane to close one launch-critical OCR concurrency flaw without mutating the dirty attached root or production. Atomic spend activation is not yet migration-safe because deployed Worker secrets do not include OCR_ACCOUNTING_HMAC_KEY; evaluating the existing live Durable Object as a fail-closed App Attest signCount replay authority instead.

Closed the attested OCR assertion replay race with the existing SQLite Durable Object before cache/provider work, added a defense-in-depth KV rollback fence, and required rollback artifacts to retain the atomic guard. Proof: focused 40/40, full Node 621/621, Worker 16/16 including 64-way concurrency, smoke green, root and production dry-runs green, zero production dependency vulnerabilities, and independent security review SHIP with no P1/P2; no secret write, deploy, paid OCR call, or production mutation occurred.
